prompt: In a photorealistic photo, the humid air of a sprawling botanical greenhouse hangs heavy with moisture. On the left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands beside a tall fern, her hand resting gently on a broad leaf. Next to her, a small child in blue overalls points excitedly at a cluster of orchids blooming high above. In the center, an elderly man with a white beard sits on a weathered wooden bench, his posture relaxed as he watches the scene unfold. Beside him, a black cat curls up tightly, sleeping soundly on the slats. To the right, a gardener in green coveralls hands a trowel to a young assistant wearing glasses, their fingers brushing briefly during the exchange. Behind them, a large glass pane reflects the lush interior, showing the distorted image of a hanging basket filled with ivy. A brown dog lies near the entrance, its head resting on its paws while looking toward the central bench. Above the dog, a brass misting nozzle drips water onto a nearby pot of succulents. The assistant looks at the trowel with curiosity, while the gardener smiles warmly. There is no artificial lighting visible in the frame, relying solely on natural daylight filtering through the glass roof. There is no electronic equipment or modern technology present in this serene setting. The woman in the yellow raincoat appears focused on the plant life, ignoring the activity around her. The child in blue overalls maintains their upward gaze, captivated by the vibrant colors of the flowers. The elderly man with the white beard remains still, embodying a sense of calm amidst the growth. The black cat does not move, deeply asleep. The gardener in green coveralls continues their work methodically. The young assistant wearing glasses holds the tool carefully. The brown dog stays put near the door. The hanging basket sways slightly in the breeze. The succulents glisten with fresh droplets. The glass pane remains clear and unbroken.
